parameters.content:
## Configure once; no custom IDs or tool mappings
1. Import Kaapi-Day3-Ticket-Log.csv into a NEW Google Sheet.
2. On the THREE Sheets nodes select your Google credential, this document and the same imported tab. Automatic column mapping is already set.
3. On BOTH Slack nodes select your Slack credential and your support channel from the list. Invite the connected app if needed.
4. Publish. In 01 Save ticket select this workflow.

The upper review branch runs in the background and really waits for Approve/Reject. The chat does not hang waiting for an approver. A second event row records the decision, preserving an audit trail. This records review, not a real financial refund.

## Honest status
Ticket saved and Slack notified are separate facts. A failed Slack call does not repeat the Sheet append. Repeating the same question in the same session/day reuses its request ID and skips the second append.

Google Sheets lookup + append is NOT an atomic unique constraint. Concurrent duplicates can race. Before real multi-user customer deployment use a database unique key/outbox, per-user auth, queue/rate controls and restricted approvers. Demo approval links are bearer links; only trusted staff should have the channel.
